mandates.duty_text: Inform the Department of Transportation of the locations of any tree plantings planned for the immediately subsequent tree planting season within seven days following the selection of any such location.

deadline.text: not more than seven days following the selection of any such location

mandates.duty_text: The commissioner shall promulgate rules identifying at least six parks in each borough under the department's jurisdiction and determining the quantity and location of automated external defibrillators to be placed in such parks.
Submit a report to the mayor and the council regarding park features under the department’s jurisdiction that received an unacceptable inspection rating.

deadline.text: On December 31, 2022 and every six months thereafter
